description: Paid: 0.01 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.01 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Conditions report for one AI model as declared by public sources: prices, limits, modalities, listing events and vendor status. Not a ranking and makes no statement about model performance. Find ids with the free list_models tool. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

id.description: Model id from list_models, e.g. openai/gpt-4o

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: get_model_report
title: Model conditions report (paid: 0.01 RLUSD / 0.01 USDC on Base / 0.01 RLUSD on Base via x402)
